name: Customer Contracts
query:
SELECT 
    o.customer_hc, 
    o.name, 
    o.region, 
    o.branch, 
    o.branch_head,

    COUNT(co.name) AS `Total Contracts`, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN co.custom_contract_status = "Active" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Active Contracts",
    SUM(CASE WHEN co.custom_contract_status = "Expired" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Expired Contracts",
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN co.custom_contract_status = "Active" 
        AND co.expiry_date IS NOT NULL 
        AND co.expiry_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END) AS "Expiry in 6 Months",

    COUNT(d.name) AS `Total Deals`, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = "Qualified" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Qualified Deals",
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = "Won/Award" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Deals Won",
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = "Lost" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Deals Lost",

    COUNT(q.name) AS `Total Quotes`, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN q.status = "Quote Sent to Customer" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Spec-In",
    SUM(CASE WHEN q.status = "Quote Approved" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Quotes Approved",
    SUM(CASE WHEN q.status = "Quote Won" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Quotes Won"

FROM 
    `tabCRM Organization` AS o
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabCRM Contract` AS co ON o.name = co.customer
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabCRM Deal` AS d ON o.name = d.customer_name
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabCRM Quotation` AS q ON o.name = q.customer

GROUP BY 
    o.customer_hc, o.name, o.region, o.branch, o.branch_head;
